providers.name: GF Rewards
providers.operator: 株式会社フクロウラボ
providers.reviewNote: Official GF Rewards privacy information states that CookieID is automatically acquired to identify users who satisfy reward conditions. POIGAME LAB therefore records only first-party-observed provider presence and does not fetch provider offerwall URLs.

providers.name: AppDriver
providers.reviewNote: The publicly accessible AppDriver web offerwall integration guide shows request URLs carrying identifier (UserID), media_id and digest. Because the production offerwall is therefore not treated as an anonymous catalog, POIGAME LAB records passive provider presence only and does not request offerwall URLs.

providers.name: SKYFLAG
providers.reviewNote: Current official materials describe SKYFLAG offerwalls, API integration, user-segment optimization and recommended rewards, but do not establish an anonymous public campaign catalog suitable for unattended evidence retrieval. POIGAME LAB therefore records passive provider presence only.
